specMs.why: CLAUDE.md budget: process launch to the index screen's first content frame, median of 10. pnpm perf:cold enforces it on Apple Silicon hardware. Hosted macos-15 runners cannot reach it, so CI enforces hostedCiMs instead and prints this verdict as information.

hostedCiMs.why: End-to-end budget on hosted macos-15. Three VMs of the same image measured series medians of 1449, 475, and 1634 ms with this harness, so the runner, not the app, sets the floor. 1.5 times the worst median, rounded up.

hostedNavToPaintMs.why: Navigation start to first content frame on hosted macos-15, the part the frontend controls. The same three VMs measured 242, 84, and 250 ms. 1.5 times the worst median, rounded up.

warmupRuns.why: The first launch of a fresh build pays signature checks and a cold page cache. Users see it once after brew upgrade, so it is logged and discarded.

timedRuns.why: SPEC: median of 10 runs. With an even count the median is the mean of the 5th and 6th sorted runs.

p95Ms.why: CLAUDE.md budget: key event to the first frame that shows the typed character, p95 in Playwright WebKit (EDIT-14).

hostedAppOwnedP95Ms.why: The app's share of key-to-paint on hosted macos-15: key event to the end of the input handler, plus the rendering update from the rAF callback to the MessageChannel task after it. One 60 Hz frame is 16 ms, so the app must finish its own work inside that. The tick wait in between, which the runner's 17 ms display tick sets, is reported, not gated. The keystroke job gates this with AELOMI_PERF_CI=1. pnpm perf:keystroke gates p95Ms, the full key-to-paint, on Apple Silicon.

gate.why: The surface whose p95 the keystroke job fails on, in both modes; the other surface is reported. Calibration of the split on hosted macos-15 decides which surface: the 5,000-block surface if its app-owned p95 clears hostedAppOwnedP95Ms in every calibration run, otherwise the empty surface. Moves to the real editor when BlockNote lands.

pageLoads.why: Three fresh page loads so one bad load cannot decide the verdict.

samplesPerLoad.why: 300 keys per load. With 30 discarded, 270 kept per load and 810 pooled for the p95.

discardedPerLoad.why: Frames right after a load are irregular. The first keys warm the page and are not counted.

gapMs.why: Keys 100 ms apart let the display link go idle between samples. Back-to-back keys measure vsync wait, not the app.
